diagnosis: The custom_jwt_payload_handler extracts an arbitrary target company identifier from user-controlled request headers (X-Company-ID) or request body data and writes it directly into the signed JWT claims without verifying whether the authenticating user holds active membership in that company. An attacker can supply any victim company's identifier during login to generate a valid signed token scoped to that organization.
